channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: From rallies to AI propaganda: LeT, JeM plot more lethal comeback, target 10,000 recruits
item.description: The year 2026 would be majorly about re-grouping and also making the outfits doubly lethal, an officer said. Both these groups were hit the hardest during Operation Sindoor, launched by the Indian armed forces to avenge the Pahalgam attack.

item.title: Will Sanjay Leela Bhansali' 'Love & War' be delayed again? Ramayana team appears disappointed with news
item.description: Alia Bhatt, Vicky Kaushal and Ranbir Kapoor starrer Love & War's release date has been postponed yet again and there is a possibility that the other projects that these stars have lined up might suffer.

item.title: India's 2025 economic reforms lay foundation for inclusive growth
item.description: By simplifying taxation, modernising labour laws, strengthening MSMEs, boosting rural employment and advancing digital payments, these measures collectively foster trust, resilience and global competitiveness in India's economy, according to an official statement issued on Tuesday.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty end flat amid mixed sectoral cues
item.description: The Sensex closed at 84,675.08, slipping 20.46 points or 0.02 per cent, while the Nifty settled marginally lower at 25,938.85, down 3.25 points or 0.01 per cent. "The Nifty has also slipped below the 21 EMA, reinforcing the short-term downtrend. Immediate support is placed in the 25,850–25,870 zone," market watchers stated.

item.title: Despite Pahalgam attack, 2025 emerges J&K's least violent year in over two decades
item.description: Despite the deadly Pahalgam terror attack that killed 26 civilians, 2025 is set to close as the least violent year in Jammu and Kashmir in more than 20 years. Official police data shows a sharp decline in terror-related incidents.

item.title: 'Spoke about Kerala govt's interference in Karnataka, not about Keralites': Deputy CM Shivakumar
item.description: Responding to media queries at the Vidhana Soudha on Tuesday, Shivakumar said, "I only stated that the Kerala Chief Minister and the Kerala government should not interfere in the administration of the Karnataka government. I did not speak about Keralites. Rajeev Chandrasekhar is misrepresenting my statement and misleading people."

item.title: Another Hindu man shot dead in Bangladesh amid continuous attacks on minorities
item.description: The Bangladesh Ansar and Village Defence Force, also known as the Ansar Bahini, is a paramilitary auxiliary force under the Ministry of Home Affairs, responsible for internal security and law enforcement in the country.

item.title: MCA extends FY25 annual filing deadline to January 31, 2026 amid portal glitches
item.description: The earlier deadline of December 31 was extended after a large number of users complained about technical problems on the MCA portal. Filers reported frequent timeouts, glitches and system errors that made it difficult to upload documents and complete submissions on time.

item.title: US-led strikes net 25 ISIS operatives in Syria
item.description: CENTCOM said the actions followed the launch of Operation Hawkeye Strike on December 19, when US and Jordanian forces struck more than 70 ISIS targets using over 100 precision munitions.

item.title: Kartik Aaryan takes dig at Dhurandhar; Karan Johar says Aditya Dhar's film made him question his ability as filmmaker
item.description: Kartik Aaryan's film Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri was released on December 25, but after it failed to garner numbers against Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar, the actor re-shared a post that referred to Dhurandhar as a testosterone-boasting film. Following backlash over the post, Kartik Aaryan deleted the comment.
